board.title: Board
board.subtitle: Everything in flight, in a column per whatever you're grouping by.

closedWindow.one: Done and Cancelled show the last day.
closedWindow.other: Done and Cancelled show the last {count} days.

board.columnEmptyHint: Drag a card here, or add one with the + button.

slaBadgeLabel.one: {count} item past its SLA in this column
slaBadgeLabel.other: {count} items past their SLA in this column

board.quickAddHint: Enter adds it and keeps this open for the next one. Esc closes.
board.overflowHint: These still hold work, so they keep a place here — but they can't take new cards. Move items out of them.
board.moveDisabledHint: Only the person who created or owns an item can move it.
board.errMove: That move didn't stick — the card is back where it was.
board.grabbed: Picked up ⁨{title}⁩. Drag it over a column, or press Escape to cancel.
board.holdHint: Press and hold a card to pick it up, then drag it onto another column — that changes its status, track, owner or priority, whichever you're grouped by. Swipe anywhere to move between columns.
board.dragHint: Drag a card to another column — that changes its status, track, owner or priority, whichever you're grouped by. With a card focused, the arrow keys move it one column and the number keys send it straight to one.
board.keyboardHint: No dragging needed. Tab to a card, then use the left and right arrow keys to move it one column at a time, or the number keys to send it to a numbered column. The card's own menu always sets its status, whatever the columns are showing.
board.statusAxisNote: Your status filter isn't applied here — these columns are the statuses. Group by track, owner or priority to use it, or clear it above.
board.emptyHint: Widen your filters, or clear them and start again.
board.errClosed: Couldn't load recently finished work, so Done and Cancelled may be short.
